dependency:runtime-mix:backend-runtime.decision: One backend runtime: Python 3 (standard library). B is the user's own Python code and may be adapted; A's JavaScript may not be reused (no licence file) and is rebuilt anyway.
dependency:runtime-mix:backend-runtime.note: medium; pre-approved by the benchmark operator with Claude's recommendation

application:workflow:suggestion-input.decision: The FAQ matcher reads the ticket's subject and description only; replies are not matched.
application:workflow:suggestion-input.note: medium; pre-approved by the benchmark operator with Claude's recommendation

migration:ticket.decision: Plan only: A's embedded Ticket.messages list maps to Message rows (ticket_id), so nothing is dropped. A has no persisted data (tickets live only in memory), so there is nothing to migrate now. If the user later supplies real Helpdesk data, follow design/migration-plan.md (backup, dry run on a copy, row counts).
migration:ticket.note: plan approved (pre-approved by the benchmark operator with Claude's recommendation); running any migration needs its own migration approval

migration:message.decision: Plan only: A's Message.from is always the literal 'agent'; imported messages get author_id of a dedicated 'imported from Helpdesk' agent account, and the original text is kept in the import log. No data exists to migrate now.
migration:message.note: plan approved (pre-approved by the benchmark operator); running it needs its own migration approval
